1.english_reference: And king Zedekiah the son of Josiah reigned instead of Coniah the son of Jehoiakim

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּ֨מְלָךְ מֶ֔לֶךְ צִדְקִיָּ֖הוּ בֶּן יֹֽאשִׁיָּ֑הוּ תַּ֗חַת כָּנְיָ֨הוּ֙ בֶּן יְה֣וֹיָקִ֔ים
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν Σεδεκίας υἱὸς Ἰωσεία ἀντὶ Ἰωακείμ ,
traditions.VUL: Et regnávit rex Sedecías fílius Iosíæ pro Iechonía fílio Ióakim ,
traditions.KJV: And king Zedekiah the son of Josiah reigned instead of Coniah the son of Jehoiakim ,

1.english_reference: whom Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon made king in the land of Judah

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִמְלִ֛יךְ נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֥ר מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֖ל בְּ אֶ֥רֶץ יְהוּדָֽה
traditions.LXX: ὃν ἐβασίλευσεν Ναβουχοδονοσὸρ βασιλεύειν τοῦ Ἰούδα .
traditions.VUL: quem constítuit regem Nabuchodónosor rex Babylónis in terra Iuda :
traditions.KJV: whom Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon made king in the land of Judah .

2.english_reference: But neither he , nor his servants , nor the people of the land , did hearken unto the words of the LORD

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹ֥א שָׁמַ֛ע ה֥וּא וַ עֲבָדָ֖י ו וְ עַ֣ם הָ אָ֑רֶץ אֶל דִּבְרֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐκ ἤκουσαν αὐτὸς καὶ οἱ παῖδες αὐτοῦ καὶ ὁ λαὸς τῆς γῆς τοὺς λόγους Κυρίου
traditions.VUL: et non obedívit ipse , et servi eius , et pópulus terræ , verbis Dómini ,
traditions.KJV: But neither he , nor his servants , nor the people of the land , did hearken unto the words of the LORD ,

2.english_reference: which he spake by the prophet Jeremiah

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּ֔ר בְּ יַ֖ד יִרְמְיָ֥הוּ הַ נָּבִֽיא
traditions.LXX: οὓς ἐλάλησεν ἐν χειρὶ Ἰερεμίου .
traditions.VUL: quæ locútus est in manu Ieremíæ prophétæ .
traditions.KJV: which he spake by the prophet Jeremiah .

3.english_reference: And Zedekiah the king sent Jehucal the son of Shelemiah and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest to the prophet Jeremiah

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּשְׁלַח֩ הַ מֶּ֨לֶךְ צִדְקִיָּ֜הוּ אֶת יְהוּכַ֣ל בֶּן שֶֽׁלֶמְיָ֗ה וְ אֶת צְפַנְיָ֤הוּ בֶן מַֽעֲשֵׂיָה֙ הַ כֹּהֵ֔ן אֶל יִרְמְיָ֥הוּ הַ נָּבִ֖יא
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν ὁ βασιλεὺς Σεδεκίας τὸν Ἰωαχὰλ υἱὸν Σελεμίου καὶ τὸν Σοφονίαν υἱὸν Μαασαίου τὸν ἱερέα πρὸς Ἰερεμίαν
traditions.VUL: Et misit rex Sedecías Iuchal fílium Selemíæ , et Sophoníam fílium Maasíæ sacerdótem , ad Ieremíam prophétam ,
traditions.KJV: And Zedekiah the king sent Jehucal the son of Shelemiah and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest to the prophet Jeremiah ,

3.english_reference: saying , Pray now unto the LORD our God for us

traditions.WLC: לֵ אמֹ֑ר הִתְפַּלֶּל נָ֣א בַעֲדֵ֔ נוּ אֶל יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵֽי נוּ
traditions.LXX: λέγων Πρόσευξαι δὴ περὶ ἡμῶν πρὸς Κύριον .
traditions.VUL: dicens : Ora pro nobis Dóminum Deum nostrum .
traditions.KJV: saying , Pray now unto the LORD our God for us .

4.english_reference: Now Jeremiah came in and went out among the people

traditions.WLC: וְ יִרְמְיָ֕הוּ בָּ֥א וְ יֹצֵ֖א בְּ ת֣וֹךְ הָ עָ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ Ἰερεμίας ἦλθεν καὶ διῆλθεν διὰ μέσου τῆς πόλεως ,
traditions.VUL: Ieremías autem líbere ambulábat in médio pópuli :
traditions.KJV: Now Jeremiah came in and went out among the people :

4.english_reference: for they had not put him into prison

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹֽא נָתְנ֥וּ אֹת֖ וֹ בֵּ֥ית ה כליא
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐκ ἔδωκαν αὐτὸν εἰς οἶκον τῆς φυλακῆς .
traditions.VUL: non enim míserant eum in custódiam cárceris . Igitur exércitus Pharaónis egréssus est de Ægýpto : et audiéntes Chaldǽi , qui obsidébant Ierúsalem , huiuscémodi núntium , recessérunt ab Ierúsalem .
traditions.KJV: for they had not put him into prison .

traditions.VUL: Ieremías autem líbere ambulábat in médio pópuli : non enim míserant eum in custódiam cárceris .

5.english_reference: Then Pharaoh ’s army was come forth out of Egypt :

traditions.WLC: וְ חֵ֥יל פַּרְעֹ֖ה יָצָ֣א מִ מִּצְרָ֑יִם
traditions.LXX: καὶ δύναμις Φαραὼ ἐξῆλθεν ἐξ Αἰγύπτου ,
traditions.VUL: Igitur exércitus Pharaónis egréssus est de Ægýpto :
traditions.KJV: Then Pharaoh ’s army was come forth out of Egypt :

5.english_reference: and when the Chaldeans that besieged Jerusalem heard tidings of them ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּשְׁמְע֨וּ הַ כַּשְׂדִּ֜ים הַ צָּרִ֤ים עַל יְרוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ אֶת שִׁמְעָ֔ ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἤκουσαν οἱ Χαλδαῖοι τὴν ἀκοὴν αὐτῶν ,
traditions.VUL: et audiéntes Chaldǽi , qui obsidébant Ierúsalem , huiuscémodi núntium ,
traditions.KJV: and when the Chaldeans that besieged Jerusalem heard tidings of them ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יֵּ֣עָל֔וּ מֵ עַ֖ל יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀνέβησαν ἐπὶ Ἰερουσαλήμ .
traditions.VUL: recessérunt ab Ierúsalem .
traditions.KJV: they departed from Jerusalem .

6.english_reference: Then came the word of the LORD unto the prophet Jeremiah , saying ,

traditions.WLC: וַֽ יְהִי֙ דְּבַר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל יִרְמְיָ֥הוּ הַ נָּבִ֖יא לֵ אמֹֽר
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος Κυρίου πρὸς Ἰερεμίαν λέγων .
traditions.VUL: Et factum est verbum Dómini ad Ieremíam prophétam , dicens :
traditions.KJV: Then came the word of the LORD unto the prophet Jeremiah , saying ,

7.english_reference: Thus saith the LORD , the God of Israel

traditions.WLC: כֹּֽה אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל
traditions.LXX: Οὕτως εἶπεν Κύριος
traditions.VUL: Hæc dicit Dóminus Deus Israel :
traditions.KJV: Thus saith the LORD , the God of Israel ;

7.english_reference: Thus shall ye say to the king of Judah , that sent you unto me to inquire of me

traditions.WLC: כֹּ֤ה תֹֽאמְרוּ֙ אֶל מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה הַ שֹּׁלֵ֧חַ אֶתְ כֶ֛ם אֵלַ֖ י לְ דָרְשֵׁ֑ נִי
traditions.LXX: Οὕτως ἐρεῖς πρὸς βασιλέα Ἰούδα τὸν ἀποστείλαντα πρὸς σὲ τοῦ ἐκζητῆσαί με
traditions.VUL: Sic dicétis regi Iuda , qui misit vos ad me interrogándum :
traditions.KJV: Thus shall ye say to the king of Judah , that sent you unto me to inquire of me ;

7.english_reference: Behold , Pharaoh ’s army , which is come forth to help you , shall return to Egypt into their own land

traditions.WLC: הִנֵּ֣ה חֵ֣יל פַּרְעֹ֗ה הַ יֹּצֵ֤א לָ כֶם֙ לְ עֶזְרָ֔ה שָׁ֥ב לְ אַרְצ֖ וֹ מִצְרָֽיִם
traditions.LXX: Ἰδοὺ δύναμις Φαραὼ ἡ ἐξελθοῦσα ὑμῖν εἰς βοήθειαν ἀποστρέψουσιν εἰς γῆν Αἰγύπτου ,
traditions.VUL: Ecce exércitus Pharaónis , qui egréssus est vobis in auxílium , revertétur in terram suam in Ægýptum :
traditions.KJV: Behold , Pharaoh ’s army , which is come forth to help you , shall return to Egypt into their own land .

8.english_reference: And the Chaldeans shall come again , and fight against this city

traditions.WLC: וְ שָׁ֨בוּ֙ הַ כַּשְׂדִּ֔ים וְ נִלְחֲמ֖וּ עַל הָ עִ֣יר הַ זֹּ֑את
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀναστρέψουσιν αὐτοὶ οἱ Χαλδαῖοι καὶ πολεμήσουσιν ἐπὶ τὴν πόλιν ταύτην ,
traditions.VUL: et rédient Chaldǽi , et bellábunt contra civitátem hanc ,
traditions.KJV: And the Chaldeans shall come again , and fight against this city ,

8.english_reference: and take it , and burn it with fire

traditions.WLC: וּ לְכָדֻ֖ הָ וּ שְׂרָפֻ֥ הָ בָ אֵֽשׁ
traditions.LXX: καὶ συλλήμψονται αὐτὴν καὶ καύσουσιν αὐτὴν πυρί .
traditions.VUL: et cápient eam , et succéndent eam igni .
traditions.KJV: and take it , and burn it with fire .

9.english_reference: Thus saith the LORD ; Deceive not yourselves , saying , The Chaldeans shall surely depart from us

traditions.WLC: כֹּ֣ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה אַל תַּשִּׁ֤אוּ נַפְשֹֽׁתֵי כֶם֙ לֵ אמֹ֔ר הָלֹ֛ךְ יֵלְכ֥וּ מֵ עָלֵ֖י נוּ הַ כַּשְׂדִּ֑ים
traditions.LXX: ὅτι οὕτως εἶπεν Κύριος Μὴ ὑπολάβητε ταῖς ψυχαῖς ὑμῶν λέγοντες Ἀποτρέχοντες ἀπελεύσονται ἀφ᾽ ἡμῶν οἱ Χαλδαῖοι ,
traditions.VUL: Hæc dicit Dóminus : Nolíte decípere ánimas vestras , dicéntes : Eúntes abíbunt , et recédent a nobis Chaldǽi :
traditions.KJV: Thus saith the LORD ; Deceive not yourselves , saying , The Chaldeans shall surely depart from us :

traditions.WLC: כִּי לֹ֖א יֵלֵֽכוּ
traditions.LXX: ὅτι οὐ μὴ ἀπέλθωσιν ,
traditions.VUL: quia non abíbunt .
traditions.KJV: for they shall not depart .

10.english_reference: For though ye had smitten the whole army of the Chaldeans that fight against you , and there remained [ but ] wounded men among them

traditions.WLC: כִּ֣י אִם הִכִּיתֶ֞ם כָּל חֵ֤יל כַּשְׂדִּים֙ הַ נִּלְחָמִ֣ים אִתְּ כֶ֔ם וְ נִ֨שְׁאֲרוּ בָ֔ ם אֲנָשִׁ֖ים מְדֻקָּרִ֑ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐὰν πατάξητε πᾶσαν δύναμιν τῶν Χαλδαίων τοὺς πολεμοῦντας ὑμᾶς , καὶ καταλειφθῶσίν τινες ἐκkeκεντημένοι ,
traditions.VUL: Sed etsi percusséritis omnem exércitum Chaldæórum , qui prœliántur advérsum vos , et derelícti fúerint ex eis áliqui vulneráti ,
traditions.KJV: For though ye had smitten the whole army of the Chaldeans that fight against you , and there remained [ but ] wounded men among them , [ yet ]

10.english_reference: [ yet ] should they rise up every man in his tent , and burn this city with fire

traditions.WLC: אִ֤ישׁ בְּ אָהֳל וֹ֙ יָק֔וּמוּ וְ שָֽׂרְפ֛וּ אֶת הָ עִ֥יר הַ זֹּ֖את בָּ אֵֽשׁ
traditions.LXX: ἕκαστος ἐν τῷ τόπῳ αὐτοῦ οὗτοι ἀναστήσονται καὶ καύσουσιν τὴν πόλιν ταύτην ἐν πυρί .
traditions.VUL: sínguli de tentório suo consúrgent , et incéndent civitátem hanc igni .
traditions.KJV: should they rise up every man in his tent , and burn this city with fire .

11.english_reference: And it came to pass , that when the army of the Chaldeans was broken up from Jerusalem

traditions.WLC: וְ הָיָ֗ה בְּ הֵֽעָלוֹת֙ חֵ֣יל הַ כַּשְׂדִּ֔ים מֵ עַ֖ל יְרֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἐγένετο ὅτε ἀνέβη ἡ δύναμις τῶν Χαλδαίων ἀπὸ Ἰερουσαλὴμ
traditions.VUL: Ergo cum recessísset exércitus Chaldæórum ab Ierúsalem
traditions.KJV: And it came to pass , that when the army of the Chaldeans was broken up from Jerusalem

traditions.WLC: מִ פְּנֵ֖י חֵ֥יל פַּרְעֹֽה
traditions.LXX: ἀπὸ προσώπου τῆς δυνάμεως Φαραώ ,
traditions.VUL: propter exércitum Pharaónis ,
traditions.KJV: for fear of Pharaoh ’s army ,

12.english_reference: Then Jeremiah went forth out of Jerusalem

traditions.WLC: וַ יֵּצֵ֤א יִרְמְיָ֨הוּ֙ מִ יר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם
traditions.LXX: ἐξῆλθεν Ἰερεμίας ἀπὸ Ἰερουσαλὴμ
traditions.VUL: egréssus est Ieremías de Ierúsalem
traditions.KJV: Then Jeremiah went forth out of Jerusalem

12.english_reference: to go into the land of Benjamin

traditions.WLC: לָ לֶ֖כֶת אֶ֣רֶץ בִּנְיָמִ֑ן
traditions.LXX: τοῦ πορευθῆναι εἰς γῆν Βενιαμεὶν
traditions.VUL: ut iret in terram Béniamin ,
traditions.KJV: to go into the land of Benjamin ,

12.english_reference: to separate himself thence in the midst of the people

traditions.WLC: לַ חֲלִ֥ק מִ שָּׁ֖ם בְּ ת֥וֹךְ הָ עָֽם
traditions.LXX: τοῦ ἀγοράσαι ἐκεῖθεν ἐν μέσῳ τοῦ λαοῦ .
traditions.VUL: et divíderet ibi possessiónem in conspéctu cívium .
traditions.KJV: to separate himself thence in the midst of the people .

13.english_reference: And when he was in the gate of Benjamin

traditions.WLC: וַ יְהִי ה֞וּא בְּ שַׁ֣עַר בִּנְיָמִ֗ן
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐγένετο αὐτὸς ἐν πύλῃ Βενιαμείν ,
traditions.VUL: Cumque pervenísset ad portam Béniamin ,
traditions.KJV: And when he was in the gate of Benjamin ,

13.english_reference: a captain of the ward [ was ] there

traditions.WLC: וְ שָׁם֙ בַּ֣עַל פְּקִדֻ֔ת
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐκεῖ ἄνθρωπος παρ᾽ ᾧ κατέλυεν
traditions.VUL: erat ibi custos portæ per vices ,
traditions.KJV: a captain of the ward [ was ] there ,

13.english_reference: whose name [ was ] Irijah , the son of Shelemiah , the son of Hananiah

traditions.WLC: וּ שְׁמ וֹ֙ יִרְאִיָּ֔יה בֶּן שֶֽׁלֶמְיָ֖ה בֶּן חֲנַנְיָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: Σαρουιὰ υἱὸς Σελεμίου υἱοῦ Ἁνανίου ,
traditions.VUL: nómine Ierías fílius Selemíæ fílii Hananíæ :
traditions.KJV: whose name [ was ] Irijah , the son of Shelemiah , the son of Hananiah ;

13.english_reference: and he took Jeremiah the prophet

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּתְפֹּ֞שׂ אֶֽת יִרְמְיָ֤הוּ הַ נָּבִיא֙
traditions.LXX: καὶ συνέλαβεν τὸν Ἰερεμίαν
traditions.VUL: et apprehéndit Ieremíam prophétam ,
traditions.KJV: and he took Jeremiah the prophet ,

13.english_reference: saying , Thou fallest away to the Chaldeans

traditions.WLC: לֵ אמֹ֔ר אֶל הַ כַּשְׂדִּ֖ים אַתָּ֥ה נֹפֵֽל
traditions.LXX: λέγων Πρὸς τοὺς Χαλδαίους σὺ φεύγεις ?
traditions.VUL: dicens : Ad Chaldǽos prófugis .
traditions.KJV: saying , Thou fallest away to the Chaldeans .

14.english_reference: Then said Jeremiah , [ It is ] false ; I fall not away to the Chaldeans

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֨אמֶר יִרְמְיָ֜הוּ שֶׁ֗קֶר אֵינֶ֤ נִּי נֹפֵל֙ עַל הַ כַּשְׂדִּ֔ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν Ψεῦδος · οὐκ εἰς τοὺς Χαλδαίους ἐγὼ φεύγω .
traditions.VUL: Et respóndit Ieremías : Falsum est , non fúgio ad Chaldǽos .
traditions.KJV: Then said Jeremiah , [ It is ] false ; I fall not away to the Chaldeans .

14.english_reference: But he hearkened not to him

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹ֥א שָׁמַ֖ע אֵלָ֑י
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐκ εἰσήκουσεν αὐτοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: Et non audívit eum :
traditions.KJV: But he hearkened not to him :

traditions.WLC: ו וַ יִּתְפֹּ֤שׂ יִרְאִיָּיה֙ בְּ יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ συνέλαβεν Σαρουιὰ τὸν Ἰερεμίαν
traditions.VUL: sed comprehéndit Ierías Ieremíam ,
traditions.KJV: so Irijah took Jeremiah ,

14.english_reference: and brought him to the princes

traditions.WLC: וַ יְבִאֵ֖ הוּ אֶל הַ שָּׂרִֽים
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἰσήγαγεν αὐτὸν πρὸς τοὺς ἄρχοντας .
traditions.VUL: et addúxit eum ad príncipes .
traditions.KJV: and brought him to the princes .

15.english_reference: Wherefore the princes were wroth with Jeremiah , and smote him

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּקְצְפ֧וּ הַ שָּׂרִ֛ים עַֽל יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ וְ הִכּ֣וּ אֹת֑ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπικράνθησαν οἱ ἄρχοντες ἐπὶ Ἰερεμίαν καὶ ἐπάταξαν αὐτόν ,
traditions.VUL: Quam ob rem iráti príncipes contra Ieremíam , cæsum eum
traditions.KJV: Wherefore the princes were wroth with Jeremiah , and smote him ,

15.english_reference: and put him in prison in the house of Jonathan the scribe

traditions.WLC: וְ נָתְנ֨וּ אוֹת֜ וֹ בֵּ֣ית הָ אֵס֗וּר בֵּ֚ית יְהוֹנָתָ֣ן הַ סֹּפֵ֔ר
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀπέστειλαν αὐτὸν εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν Ἰωναθὰμ τοῦ γραμματέως ,
traditions.VUL: misérunt in cárcerem , qui erat in domo Iónathan scribæ :
traditions.KJV: and put him in prison in the house of Jonathan the scribe :

15.english_reference: for they had made that the prison

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי אֹת֥ וֹ עָשׂ֖וּ לְ בֵ֥ית הַ כֶּֽלֶא
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ταύτην ἐποίησαν εἰς οἰκίαν φυλακῆς .
traditions.VUL: ipse enim præpósitus erat super cárcerem .
traditions.KJV: for they had made that the prison .

16.english_reference: When Jeremiah was entered into the dungeon , and into the cabins

traditions.WLC: כִּ֣י בָ֧א יִרְמְיָ֛הוּ אֶל בֵּ֥ית הַ בּ֖וֹר וְ אֶל הַֽ חֲנֻ֑יוֹת
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἦλθεν Ἰερεμίας εἰς οἰκίαν τοῦ λάκκου καὶ εἰς τὴν χερέθ ,
traditions.VUL: Itaque ingréssus est Ieremías in domum laci et in ergástulum :
traditions.KJV: When Jeremiah was entered into the dungeon , and into the cabins ,

16.english_reference: and Jeremiah had remained there many days

traditions.WLC: וַ יֵּֽשֶׁב שָׁ֥ם יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ יָמִ֥ים רַבִּֽים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐκάθισεν ἐκεῖ ἡμέρας πολλάς .
traditions.VUL: et sedit ibi Ieremías diébus multis .
traditions.KJV: and Jeremiah had remained there many days ;

17.english_reference: Then Zedekiah the king sent , and took him out

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּשְׁלַח֩ הַ מֶּ֨לֶךְ צִדְקִיָּ֜הוּ וַ יִּקָּחֵ֗ הוּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Σεδεκίας καὶ ἐκάλεσεν αὐτόν ,
traditions.VUL: Mittens autem Sedecías rex , tulit eum :
traditions.KJV: Then Zedekiah the king sent , and took him out :

17.english_reference: and the king asked him secretly in his house

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּשְׁאָלֵ֨ הוּ הַ מֶּ֤לֶךְ בְּ בֵית וֹ֙ בַּ סֵּ֔תֶר
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἠρώτα αὐτὸν ὁ βασιλεὺς κρυφαίως εἰπεῖν
traditions.VUL: et interrogávit eum in domo sua abscóndite ,
traditions.KJV: and the king asked him secretly in his house ,

17.english_reference: and said , Is there [ any ] word from the LORD ?

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֕אמֶר הֲ יֵ֥שׁ דָּבָ֖ר מֵ אֵ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: Εἰ ἔστιν ὁ λόγος παρὰ Κυρίου ?
traditions.VUL: et dixit : Putásne est sermo a Dómino ?
traditions.KJV: and said , Is there [ any ] word from the LORD ?

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֤אמֶר יִרְמְיָ֨הוּ֙ יֵ֔שׁ
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν Ἔστιν ·
traditions.VUL: Et dixit Ieremías : Est .
traditions.KJV: And Jeremiah said , There is :

17.english_reference: for , said he , thou shalt be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֕אמֶר בְּ יַ֥ד מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֖ל תִּנָּתֵֽן
traditions.LXX: εἰς χεῖρας βασιλέως Βαβυλῶνος παραδοθήσῃ .
traditions.VUL: Et ait : In manus regis Babylónis tradéris .
traditions.KJV: for , said he , thou shalt be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon .

18.english_reference: Moreover Jeremiah said unto king Zedekiah

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֣אמֶר יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ אֶל הַ מֶּ֖לֶךְ צִדְקִיָּ֑הוּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν Ἰερεμίας τῷ βασιλεῖ
traditions.VUL: Et dixit Ieremías ad regem Sedecíam :
traditions.KJV: Moreover Jeremiah said unto king Zedekiah ,

18.english_reference: What have I offended against thee , or against thy servants , or against this people

traditions.WLC: מֶה֩ חָטָ֨אתִֽי לְ ךָ֤ וְ לַ עֲבָדֶ֨י ךָ֙ וְ לָ עָ֣ם הַ זֶּ֔ה
traditions.LXX: Τί ἠδίκησά σε καὶ τοὺς παῖδάς σου καὶ τὸν λαὸν τοῦτον ,
traditions.VUL: Quid peccávi tibi , et servis tuis , et pópulo tuo ,
traditions.KJV: What have I offended against thee , or against thy servants , or against this people ,

18.english_reference: that ye have put me in prison ?

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי נְתַתֶּ֥ם אוֹתִ֖ י אֶל בֵּ֥ית הַ כֶּֽלֶא
traditions.LXX: ὅτι σὺ δίδως με εἰς οἰκίαν φυλακῆς ?
traditions.VUL: quia misísti me in domum cárceris ?
traditions.KJV: that ye have put me in prison ?

19.english_reference: Where [ are ] now your prophets which prophesied unto you

traditions.WLC: ו אי ו נְבִ֣יאֵי כֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁר נִבְּא֥וּ לָ כֶ֖ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ποῦ εἰσιν οἱ προφῆται ὑμῶν οἱ προφητεύσαντες ὑμῖν
traditions.VUL: Ubi sunt prophétæ vestri , qui prophetábant vobis ,
traditions.KJV: Where [ are ] now your prophets which prophesied unto you ,

19.english_reference: saying , The king of Babylon shall not come against you , nor against this land ?

traditions.WLC: לֵ אמֹ֑ר לֹֽא יָבֹ֤א מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶל֙ עֲלֵי כֶ֔ם וְ עַ֖ל הָ אָ֥רֶץ הַ זֹּֽאת
traditions.LXX: λέγοντες ὅτι Οὐ μὴ ἔλθῃ βασιλεὺς Βαβυλῶνος ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν ταύτην ?
traditions.VUL: et dicébant : Non véniet rex Babylónis super vos , et super terram hanc ?
traditions.KJV: saying , The king of Babylon shall not come against you , nor against this land ?

20.english_reference: Therefore hear now , I pray thee , O my lord the king

traditions.WLC: וְ עַתָּ֕ה שְֽׁמַֽע נָ֖א אֲדֹנִ֣ י הַ מֶּ֑לֶךְ
traditions.LXX: καὶ νῦν , κύριε βασιλεῦ ,
traditions.VUL: Nunc ergo audi óbsecro dómine mi rex :
traditions.KJV: Therefore hear now , I pray thee , O my lord the king :

20.english_reference: let my supplication , I pray thee , be accepted before thee

traditions.WLC: תִּפָּל נָ֤א תְחִנָּתִ י֙ לְ פָנֶ֔י ךָ
traditions.LXX: πεσέτω τὸ ἔλεός μου κατὰ πρόσωπόν σου ·
traditions.VUL: váleat deprecátio mea in conspéctu tuo ,
traditions.KJV: let my supplication , I pray thee , be accepted before thee ;

20.english_reference: that thou cause me not to return to the house of Jonathan the scribe

traditions.WLC: וְ אַל תְּשִׁבֵ֗ נִי בֵּ֚ית יְהוֹנָתָ֣ן הַ סֹּפֵ֔ר
traditions.LXX: καὶ τί ἀποστρέφεις με εἰς οἰκίαν Ἰωναθὰμ τοῦ γραμματέως ,
traditions.VUL: et ne me remíttas in domum Iónathan scribæ ,
traditions.KJV: that thou cause me not to return to the house of Jonathan the scribe ,

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹ֥א אָמ֖וּת שָֽׁם
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐ μὴ ἀποθάνω ἐκεῖ ?
traditions.VUL: ne móriar ibi .
traditions.KJV: lest I die there .

21.english_reference: Then Zedekiah the king commanded that they should commit Jeremiah into the court of the prison

traditions.WLC: וַ יְצַוֶּ֞ה הַ מֶּ֣לֶךְ צִדְקִיָּ֗הוּ וַ יַּפְקִ֣דוּ אֶֽת יִרְמְיָהוּ֮ בַּ חֲצַ֣ר הַ מַּטָּרָה֒
traditions.LXX: καὶ συνέταξεν ὁ βασιλεύς , καὶ ἐνεβάλοσαν αὐτὸν εἰς οἰκίαν τῆς φυλακῆς ,
traditions.VUL: Præcépit ergo rex Sedecías ut traderétur Ieremías in vestíbulo cárceris :
traditions.KJV: Then Zedekiah the king commanded that they should commit Jeremiah into the court of the prison ,

21.english_reference: and that they should give him daily a piece of bread out of the bakers ’ street

traditions.WLC: וְ נָתֹן֩ ל֨ וֹ כִכַּר לֶ֤חֶם לַ יּוֹם֙ מִ ח֣וּץ הָ אֹפִ֔ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐδίδοσαν αὐτῷ ἄρτον ἕνα τῆς ἡμέρας ἔξωθεν οὗ πέσσουσιν ,
traditions.VUL: et darétur ei torta panis quotídie , excépto pulménto ,
traditions.KJV: and that they should give him daily a piece of bread out of the bakers ’ street ,

21.english_reference: until all the bread in the city were spent

traditions.WLC: עַד תֹּ֥ם כָּל הַ לֶּ֖חֶם מִן הָ עִ֑יר
traditions.LXX: ἕως ἐξέλιπον οἱ ἄρτοι ἐκ τῆς πόλεως ·
traditions.VUL: donec consumeréntur omnes panes de civitáte :
traditions.KJV: until all the bread in the city were spent .

21.english_reference: Thus Jeremiah remained in the court of the prison

traditions.WLC: וַ יֵּ֣שֶׁב יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ בַּ חֲצַ֖ר הַ מַּטָּרָֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐκάθισεν Ἰερεμίας ἐν τῇ αὐλῇ τῆς φυλακῆς .
traditions.VUL: et mansit Ieremías in vestíbulo carceris .
traditions.KJV: Thus Jeremiah remained in the court of the prison .
